exact_source_equation: G(t) = G0 × exp{-exp[(Rmax × e / G0) × (λ − t) + 1]}
symbol_definitions: G0=CH4 production potential; Rmax=maximum daily CH4 production rate; λ=lag phase; t=time; e=2.71828
symbol_units: G,G0: mL CH4; Rmax: mL CH4/day; λ,t: day; e: dimensionless
applicability: Batch methane-production kinetics fitted to cumulative methane curves
original_material: Fresh and ensiled urban road-verge grass
transferability: Potentially transferable only after refitting G0, Rmax and λ for each material and test protocol
source_title: Grass from Road Verges as a Substrate for Biogas Production
authors: Czubaszek, R.; Wysocka-Czubaszek, A.; Zając, G.; et al.
limitations: Empirical fit; parameters are protocol-, inoculum-, temperature- and substrate-specific.
